messages.subject: Re: Projections work
messages.body_plain:
I am interested in inputting my own environmental variable rasters into Wallace to look at vegetation distribution in Southern California. The rasters are currently all in NAD 83 California Teale Albers, which uses meters for the units. If I have all the raster layers in the same extent, cell size, and projection am I good to go?

Do you have any other tips for using user-defined rasters for the environmental variables to make it smoother?

Thank you!

>

messages.subject: Re: Projections work
messages.body_plain:
Hello,

Unfortunately, there is not possible to use a projected coordinate system on Wallace (e.g. NAD 83 California Teale Albers). I suggest you to transform your data to WGS84 (the geographic coordinates system that Wallace use). You can use the spTranform function to re-project your points () and projectRaster() for your raster.

Best,
Gonzalo
